definitions.explanation: Polite prefix added to nouns to show respect, often relating to the listener or a third party.

examples.japanese: ご⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}します→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
ご⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{ありません→ある：00006_aru}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
ご⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give my regards to your family.

notes:
ご is an honorific prefix used to show respect.

USAGE RULES:
- ご attaches to words of Chinese origin (⟦{漢語|かんご}→漢語：13439_kango⟧)
- お attaches to words of Japanese origin (⟦{和語|わご}→和語：12074_wago⟧)
- Some words accept both (ご⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧/お⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧)

COMMON WORDS WITH ご:
- ご⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧: (your) cooperation
- ご⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧: (your) question
- ご⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧: (your) family
- ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧: (your) contact/message
- ご⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧: (your) order
- ご⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: (your) opinion
- ご⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧: guidance
- ご⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧: explanation

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦ご{覧|らん}→ご覧：01408_goran⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please look
- ご{存知|ぞんじ}: (you) know
- ⟦ご{馳走|ちそう}→ご馳走：01336_gochisou⟧さま: thanks for the meal

RELATED WORDS:
- お: honorific prefix (for ⟦{和語|わご}→和語：12074_wago⟧)
